name: Airheads Bars Original Fruit Chewy Taffy
whyItWorks: Stretchy fruit taffy made from sugar, corn syrup, maltodextrin, and modified food starch. Free of gluten, dairy, nuts, and gelatin, yielding zero fiber residue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Chew slowly. A fun, fat-free sweet.
watchOuts: Avoid sour varieties during acute mouth or stomach ulcers.
